arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,base64,sys,os
cmd=[".claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py","call","ext.nothingness.dragByKey",
     "key=hero-seek-gesture","dx=200","dy=0","steps=10","kind=touch","snapshotStep=5","snapshotPixelRatio=1.0"]
res=subprocess.check_output(cmd,text=True)
obj=json.loads(res)
d=obj.get('duringSnapshot')
assert d and 'png_base64' in d
b64=d['png_base64']
img=base64.b64decode(b64)
out_path='/workspace/.tmp/agent_shots/during_seek.png'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out_path),exist_ok=True)
open(out_path,'wb').write(img)
print('wrote',out_path,'size',len(img))
PY
